notes: 0.2.0 测试版：MCP stdio 不再弹窗，启动即隐入托盘（stdin 结束自动退出）；新增会话卫生工具与脚本列表常驻、双分隔条可拖拽并记忆占比；修复标题栏/分隔条悬停残留、分屏顶部边框缺口、托盘唤回后窗口框架退化，以及点击菜单栏标题秒退；崩溃转储补 dmp 状态、异常地址与调用链；快捷键默认只保留记事本那 13 条（复制/剪切/新建等），全局行名称常红并允许裸 F1-F24；状态栏显示 CPU/内存/GPU；随包附第三方许可原件与 MCP 接入文档。
notes_en: 0.2.0 beta: MCP stdio now runs without popping a window (hides to tray, exits on stdin EOF); session hygiene tools, always-visible script list and two draggable splitters with remembered ratios; fixed stale hover on title bar/splitters, the split-view top border gap, window frame degradation after tray restore, and the menu-bar title click crash; crash reports now carry dmp status, fault address and a call chain; default shortcuts reduced to the 13 Notepad keys (copy/cut/new ...), global rows always red and bare F1-F24 allowed; status bar shows CPU/memory/GPU; upstream license texts and the MCP access doc ship with the package.
